info.title: Arango Embedding Loader API
info.description:
Load NoSQL documents (JSON, JSONL/NDJSON, CSV - optionally gzipped - or a JSON body) into an
ArangoDB collection, **embedding the field(s) you label** with the embedding provider of your
choice and storing each vector **inside the same document**.

### Concepts
* **Embedding spec** - `{source_field | template, target_field, provider | preset, model}`.
  One or more per load.
* **Providers** - pluggable: Sentence-Transformers (local Hugging Face models such as
  `NeuML/pubmedbert-base-embeddings`), OpenAI (and compatible servers), Voyage AI, Cohere,
  Amazon Bedrock, Ollama, plus any third-party plugin. See `GET /providers`.
* **Profiles** - attach an embedding spec to a collection once (`PUT /collections/{name}/profile`);
  every later load into it is embedded automatically, and an optional watcher embeds documents
  inserted by any other client.
* **Jobs** - loads run as background jobs. Pass `?wait=true` for a synchronous response, or
  follow progress with `GET /jobs/{id}` / `GET /jobs/{id}/events` (SSE).

### Connection
The server's environment (`ARANGO_ENDPOINT`, `ARANGO_DATABASE`, `ARANGO_USERNAME`,
`ARANGO_PASSWORD`) is the default. Override it per request with the headers
`X-Arango-Endpoint`, `X-Arango-Database`, `X-Arango-Username`, `X-Arango-Password`.

get.description: Connects with the server defaults or the `X-Arango-*` header overrides and reports the server version. Never returns the password.

put.description: Creates the collection if needed and attaches an embedding profile. Afterwards every load into the collection is embedded automatically (no `embeddings` needed), and with `auto_watch` a background watcher also embeds documents inserted by any other client. Secrets in `provider_options` are never persisted - configure API keys via environment variables for profiles.

post.description: Embeds the labeled field(s) of each document and inserts the documents - with the vectors stored in the same document - into `collection`. If `embeddings` is omitted, the collection's embedding profile is used.

post.summary: Load documents from an uploaded file
post.description:
Multipart upload of a JSON array, JSONL/NDJSON or CSV file (optionally gzipped). `config` is a JSON-encoded `FileLoadOptions` object; `collection` may be given as a query parameter instead. With an embedding profile on the collection, `config` can be omitted entirely:

`curl -F file=@part1.jsonl 'http://localhost:8000/api/v1/load/file?collection=pubmed'`

vector_index_supported.title: Vector Index Supported
vector_index_supported.description: Whether the server version supports vector indexes (3.12.4+).

infer_types.title: Infer Types
infer_types.description: Convert numeric / boolean / empty cells to JSON types.

index.title: Index
index.description: Position of the document in the input.

source_field.title: Source Field
source_field.description: Dot-path of the field to embed, e.g. `text` or `content.body`.

template.title: Template
template.description: Alternative to `source_field`: compose text from several fields using `{path}` placeholders, e.g. `{title}\n\n{abstract}`.

target_field.title: Target Field
target_field.description: Field that receives the vector. Defaults to `<source_field>_embedding` (or `embedding` when using a template).

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Named preset (see `GET /presets`) that sets provider, model and options.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id. Defaults to the provider's default model.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Requested output dimension, if the model supports it.

provider_options.title: Provider Options
provider_options.description: Provider-specific options (API key, base URL, device...). Never stored.

on_missing.title: On Missing
on_missing.description: What to do when the source is missing/empty: `skip` (store document without vector), `null` (set the target to null) or `error` (reject the document).

EmbeddingFieldSpec.title: EmbeddingFieldSpec
EmbeddingFieldSpec.description: Labels a field (or template of fields) to embed and where to store the vector.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Human readable explanation or validation details.

types.title: Types
types.description: JSON types observed for this field.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Fraction of sampled documents containing it.

embeddable.title: Embeddable
embeddable.description: Heuristic: looks like text worth embedding.

result.title: Result
result.description: Extra results: vector index info, dry-run samples.

create_collection.title: Create Collection
create_collection.description: Create the collection if it is missing.

embeddings.title: Embeddings
embeddings.description: Fields to embed. Omit to use the collection's embedding profile (see `PUT /collections/{name}/profile`).

key_field.title: Key Field
key_field.description: Field whose value becomes the document `_key` (stringified).

on_duplicate.title: On Duplicate
on_duplicate.description: Behaviour when `_key` already exists: `error` (report per-document error), `update` (merge), `replace` or `ignore`. Defaults to the profile's setting or `error`.

store_metadata.title: Store Metadata
store_metadata.description: Store `<target>_meta` ({status, provider, model, dimension, embedded_at}) next to each vector. Defaults to true.

vector_index.description: Create an ArangoDB vector index after the load.
